newsitem.title: BRAZIL: BRAZIL'S GERDAU GROUP H1 NET 69 MLN REAIS.
newsitem.headline: BRAZIL'S GERDAU GROUP H1 NET 69 MLN REAIS.

text.p: Brazilian steelmaker Gerdau Group released the following January-June 1997 financial results.
Note: Figures in Brazilian reais except for exports which are in U.S. dollars.

In a statement, Gerdau Group said its consolidated net profit was up 85 percent in the first half compared with the same period last year. It added sales revenue rose 12.8 percent and physical export volume declined 22 percent.
Steel production for the group rose 4.5 percent to 1.8 million tonnes while laminated products output rose 9.5 percent to 1.6 million tonnes in the first half of 1997.
The group's unit Metalurgica Gerdau SA posted a net profit of 44.5 million reais, or 4.28 reais per 1,000 shares, up 85.8 percent over H1 1996, the statement said.

Unit Gerdau SA GER.RJ reported revenues totaling 882.5 million reais and a net profit 64.9 million reais, or 1.14 per 1,000 shares. The unit's net profit was 131.6 percent higher than the same period last year, the statement said.
